Rules.InvariantScript:
varTicketAsset &
 With(
     { d: LookUp(Equipment_Assets, Titel = varTicketAsset).DeviceName },
     If(IsBlank(d), "", "  -  " & d)
 )
"What is wrong? What have you already tried?"

"Reported by " & Coalesce(varCurrentTicket.ReportedBy.DisplayName, "?") &
 If(
     IsBlank(varCurrentTicket.ReportedDate),
     "",
     " on " & Text(varCurrentTicket.ReportedDate, DateTimeFormat.ShortDateTime24)
 ) &
 If(
     IsBlank(varCurrentTicket.ResolvedDate),
     "",
     "   |   resolved by " & Coalesce(varCurrentTicket.ResolvedBy.DisplayName, "?") &
     " on " & Text(varCurrentTicket.ResolvedDate, DateTimeFormat.ShortDate)
 )

If(
    IsBlank(If(varTicketAssetFixed, varTicketAsset, drpTkAsset.Selected.Value)),
        "Select the asset you are reporting on.",
    IsBlank(Trim(txtTkDescription.Text)), "Describe the problem.",
    ""
)
